A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VisualCloze paper, including all 18 pages and Appendices A–C. Text and visual comparisons establish identical research content; the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation experiments in Section 5, quantitative comparisons in Tables 1–3, and qualitative analyses including Appendix B and Figure 14.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original quantitative results in Tables 1–3 and qualitative experiments in the main text and appendix.

M1.justification: The visual in-context infilling method, masking procedure, positional embeddings, and FLUX fine-tuning remain identical, including the FLUX.1-dev adaptation in Appendix B.

E1.justification: Graph200K, the auxiliary training datasets in Section 3.3, and all evaluated seen and unseen task scenarios in Section 5 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within each experiment in Tables 1–3. ControlNet, OminiControl, OneDiffusion, OmniGen, the Table 3 InstantStyle [64] row, and Oursdev retain their original participation.

E3.justification: Sections 4.3 and 5.2 and Appendix C retain identical training budgets, image resizing, model configurations, context counts, evaluation procedures, and metrics.

E4.justification: The analyses of context quantity, example selection, task generalization, and foundation-model choice are identical. Appendix B and Figure 14 retain the same separate-versus-unified mean and shift comparison.

E5.justification: Figure 6 retains three outputs using different initial noises, and Figure 10 retains success reporting over three trials. Neither version adds run information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative outputs are identical. For example, Table 1 retains Oursfill depth RMSE values of 10.31, 9.91, and 9.68 for zero, one, and two in-context examples, respectively.

T1.justification: The graph and query formulations, grid construction, and Equations (1)–(2) are identical. No mathematical definitions, reasoning, assumptions, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about universal generation, unseen-task generalization, Graph200K, and alignment with image infilling.

C2.justification: Results interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning object removal, unseen-task instability, and ambiguous in-context examples.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility disclosures are identical, including LoRA rank 256, 20,000 training iterations, eight A100 GPUs, and Appendices A–C. Project and code-related links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 88 references and identical related-work discussion remain. Relationships to prior universal generation and visual in-context learning methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page margin stamp changes from v1, 10 Apr 2025 to v2, 26 Jul 2025. All paper prose, headings, terminology, and section organization are identical.

P2.justification: All 14 figures and three tables retain identical graphics, captions, formatting, and placement. Page layout is unchanged; rendering differences are confined to the version/date text.

improvement.justification: The research content, evidence, explanations, limitations, and presentation are identical across both PDFs, including the appendices. The updated arXiv stamp and administrative PDF metadata do not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
